_doc: Every visual/audio asset in this project, where it came from, its license, and how to re-fetch it. Re-derive everything: python3 projects/gogabox/tools/derive_assets.py (idempotent: re-downloads the Kenney fonts zip, re-copies CC0 audio vendored in candyrush, re-draws all PIL art, re-synthesizes sfx, regenerates thumbnails). All sources CC0; derivations inherit CC0. v0.2.4: the Space Dash set joined (Kenney space packs via OpenGameArt mirrors + the Particle Pack); recolors are deterministic tools/v024_vendor.py output (CC0 inherits). v0.3.3-p2: the owner's own Match_3_Template sprites joined (the Donut Den skin + the checker cells + the backdrop + the banner ribbon).

sources.name: Kenney - Kenney Fonts pack
sources.used_for: assets/fonts/Kenney_Rocket.ttf (display font, menu/titles), assets/fonts/Kenney_Mini.ttf (UI font, chips/labels); also used inside PIL thumbnails

sources.name: CC0 audio already vendored in projects/candyrush (originally Kenney Interface Sounds / Music Jingles, OpenGameArt pops + Happy Adventure loop, synth gaps)
sources.url: https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds ; https://kenney.nl/assets/music-jingles ; https://opengameart.org (see projects/candyrush/assets.manifest.json for exact URLs)

sources.name: OpenGameArt - Pixel Fruit Pack (via candyrush vendored copies)
sources.used_for: Fruit Slasher fruit_0..4 (upscaled 160px); fruit_gold is a deterministic gold recolor of fruit_0

sources.name: Deterministic PIL drawings (this repo, tools/derive_assets.py + tools/make_brand.py)
sources.used_for: box chrome (bg_main, logo, coin, lock/gear/trophy icons, splash, mystery tile art), snake apple/body/head x4 skins, lanes ship+block, rally ball+paddle, hopper platform+player, slasher bomb, all 14 menu thumbnails (6 games + 8 workshop teasers), icon.svg, app icon set (icons/ - chunky letter-G from the Kenney Mini font via tools/make_brand.py), android notification glyph, meta vocabulary icons (assets/meta/: genres arcade/action/puzzle/adventure/shooter/racing/kids/music/story, subs retro/singleplayer/survival/competitive/hacknslash/platformer/minimal/turnbased, age ratings everyone/kids/teens, search glyph)

sources.name: Kenney - Space Shooter Redux (OpenGameArt mirror of the kenney.nl pack)
sources.used_for: assets/games/lanes/: enemy hulls (10), 3 player hulls, laser bolts, shield bubble frames, fire animation frames, speed line, power-up/pill loot icons (Space Dash v0.2.4)

sources.name: Kenney - Space Shooter Extension 250+ (OpenGameArt)
sources.used_for: assets/games/lanes/: 4 more player ship skins, the bomb missile + its loot icon (Space Dash v0.2.4)

sources.name: Kenney - Particle Pack
sources.used_for: assets/games/lanes/fx_{flare,spark,smoke,star}.png - the tintable glow workhorses behind Space Dash's code VFX

sources.name: Space Invaders crew hulls (derived from the vendored Kenney sets)
sources.used_for: assets/games/invaders/ship_*.png - the 7 SSDS hulls are hue/recolor/glow/mount edits of the SAME Kenney hulls vendored for lanes (kenney-space-shooter-redux + extension), applied by tools/v032_invaders_art.py per the owner's 'edit some ships and change their size and colors' call. Everything else in assets/games/invaders/ is painted from scratch by that tool (CC0-clean).

sources.name: Match_3_Template.zip (owner-provided, uploaded to the session)
sources.url: owner upload (GameMaker sprite package: donuts, play-field tiles, background, banner ribbon)
sources.used_for: assets/games/matcher/gems/donut_0..4.png (the Donut Den skin gems), assets/games/matcher/bg/cell_donut_light.png + cell_donut_dark.png (the checker cells), assets/games/matcher/bg/bg_donut.png (the skin backdrop, cover-cropped 1080x1920), assets/games/matcher/fx/banner.png (the top event ribbon)

audit.policy: CC0-only, vendored, no network fetch at runtime
audit.music: 1 box theme loop (CC0, via candyrush vendored copy); games share jingles+sfx pool
audit.note: Audio kept deliberately small for v0.0.1; per-game music is a roadmap item (Docs/ideas)
